top_recommendations.title: Fix compressed-air leaks
top_recommendations.finding: Leak test shows 30.3% of compressor capacity lost to leaks (target ≤10%).
top_recommendations.action: Ultrasonic leak survey, then fix fittings, hoses and drain valves. Re-test monthly.

top_recommendations.title: Stop air compressor running after hours
top_recommendations.finding: Ran 1.5 h with no production in this period (28.7 kWh, ₹204).
top_recommendations.action: Add a timer or interlock so it stops with the line; add it to the shift-end checklist.
